factors.label: Supplier-contract linkage
factors.description: Whether a supplier can be linked to a real public contract in Mexican official procurement records (CompraNet/compras publicas).

factors.label: Corporate identity legitimacy
factors.description: Whether the supplier is a legitimate registered company, verified via Mexican public commercial registries (identity, founding date).

factors.label: Tax-list status (SAT lista 69-B)
factors.description: The supplier's status on the Mexican tax authority's lists, including lista 69-B, as a primary Mexican source.

factors.label: Sanction status
factors.description: Whether the supplier appears on sanctions lists, checked via US sanctions lists (OFAC) as secondary cross-checks only.

factors.label: Address verification
factors.description: Completeness and verifiability of the supplier's registered address as one of the five core profile fields.

factors.label: Source authority tier
factors.description: Distinction between primary Mexican official sources and secondary US cross-check sources; Mexican sources are the primary authority.

factors.label: Evidence citation completeness
factors.description: Every recorded value must cite evidence; no unsourced values are permitted, and at least 4 distinct source classes must be used.

factors.label: Core profile completeness
factors.description: Whether a linked supplier has a complete core profile across all five fields (identity, address, founding date, tax-list status, sanction status), targeted at >=80% of linked suppliers.

children.label: Awarded contract record in CompraNet/compras publicas
Supplier name/RFC match to contract party
Legal name and registration in public commercial registry
Presence on other SAT compliance lists
Address field completeness (street, city, state, ZIP)
Citation resolves to a retrievable source

classes.label: Supplier
classes.description: Company receiving public money through a Mexican government contract, with its core legitimacy profile (identity, address, founding date, tax-list status, sanction status) recorded as properties.

classes.label: Public Contract
classes.description: Awarded contract record from Mexican official procurement sources (CompraNet / compras publicas) naming a supplier as counterparty.

classes.label: Evidence Record
classes.description: Citation backing a single recorded value, resolving to a retrievable source with an authority tier.

properties.label: RFC
properties.description: Mexican tax identifier of the supplier; primary key for matching contract parties and registry records.

properties.label: Legal Name
properties.description: Registered legal name of the company (core profile: identity).

properties.label: Registry Status
properties.description: Status in the Mexican public commercial registry (active, dissolved, etc.).

properties.label: Registered Address
properties.description: Registered address of the supplier (street, city, state, ZIP) (core profile: address).

properties.label: Founding Date
properties.description: Founding/constitution date on record (core profile: founding date).

properties.label: Tax-List Status
properties.description: Status on SAT lists, including lista 69-B, from primary Mexican sources (core profile: tax-list status).

properties.label: Sanction Status
properties.description: Result of sanctions screening (OFAC SDN and other US lists) used only as secondary cross-checks (core profile: sanction status).

properties.label: Contract ID
properties.description: Official procurement identifier of the awarded contract (CompraNet / compras publicas).

properties.label: Contract Title
properties.description: Title or description of the awarded contract.

properties.label: Supplier RFC
properties.description: RFC of the awarded supplier as recorded in the procurement record.

properties.label: Agency Name
properties.description: Government agency counterparty that awarded the contract.

properties.label: Award Date
properties.description: Date the contract was awarded.

properties.label: Contract Amount
properties.description: Awarded contract amount in MXN.

properties.label: Evidence ID
properties.description: Stable identifier of the evidence citation.

properties.label: Source Name
properties.description: Name of the source backing the value (e.g., CompraNet, SIGER, SAT 69-B, OFAC SDN).

properties.label: Source Class
properties.description: Distinct source class of the citation (procurement, commercial registry, tax authority, sanctions list); used to count >=4 distinct classes.

properties.label: Source URL
properties.description: Retrievable URL where the cited source resolves.

properties.label: Authority Tier
properties.description: One of primary_mexican_source, secondary_us_crosscheck, or review_tier_source; Mexican official sources are primary authority.

properties.label: Cited Property
properties.description: Name of the supplier property whose value this evidence supports.

properties.label: Cited Value
properties.description: The recorded value being supported by this evidence.

rules.label: Supplier is linked to a real public contract (dod1)
checks: Count suppliers with at least one awarded contract in Mexican official procurement records; target >= 50.
verify: Count distinct suppliers having at least one public_contract via supplier_awards_contract; require >= 50.

rules.label: Core profile complete on supplier (dod2)
checks: All five core profile fields (identity, address, founding date, tax-list status, sanction status) present on the supplier; target >= 80% of linked suppliers.
verify: For each linked supplier, require non-null legal_name, registered_address, founding_date, tax_list_status, sanction_status; require the complete ratio >= 0.8.

rules.label: Every recorded value cites evidence (dod3)
checks: No recorded value without an evidence citation; target 0 unsourced values.
verify: For each recorded supplier value, require an evidence_record whose cited_property names that property and whose source_url resolves; count unsourced values and require 0.

rules.label: At least 4 distinct source classes used (dod4)
checks: Distinct source classes across evidence records; target >= 4.
verify: Count distinct values of source_class across evidence_record entities; require >= 4.

rules.label: Mexican official sources are primary authority (r4)
checks: Primary claims must come from Mexican official sources; US sanctions/registry lists are secondary cross-checks only.
verify: Evidence supporting primary claims must have authority_tier = primary_mexican_source; secondary_us_crosscheck evidence is cross-check only.

source_classes.label: Mexican official procurement records (CompraNet / compras publicas)
US sanctions lists (OFAC SDN) - secondary cross-check

revisions.reason: Three defects against the approved PRD. (1) The five core profile fields (identity, registered address, founding date, tax-list status, sanction status) sit on a separate core_profile class, but dod2 measures completeness on the primary class supplier, which then has no DoD properties, so dod2 can never be met. Make them properties of supplier (dod: true) and drop core_profile; keep evidence per value. (2) dod1 counts public_contract entities; the PRD says >=50 SUPPLIERS linked to real public contracts, so count suppliers with at least one awarded contract. (3) Rule r_dod4_source_class_diversity's predicate (authority_tier = primary_mexican_source) does not express its label (>=4 distinct source classes); fix or drop it, since dod4 is already measured by its query. Keep everything else. [Delegated decision by the orchestrator agent under the user's criteria, coord/briefs/approval-delegation.md]
